content.comment_body: I am trying to connect [product_name] with [product_name] using [product_name] [version_no], but I can't establish communication between [product_name] and [product_name]. I've tried several times without success. Any assistance with establishing the connection would be appreciated. I've entered all the necessary inputs like connections and IP addresses, but the link isn't working.
It would help if you could share some screenshots of your settings to make troubleshooting easier.

Hello, Have you set up a server connection in [product_name] to [product_name], as well as a connection from [product_name] to [product_name]? As [user_name] mentioned, could you upload your program or share pictures of your progress so we can check if anything is missing? There's also a video tutorial that might help; although it's in Spanish, it shows the setup steps. [url]

Thank you all for the replies. Attached are snapshots of both the controller and operator interface programs and my settings. This is a basic test to check communication. How can I control outputs directly from [product_name]?
Could you also upload your [product_name] project file? Thanks,

Hello, From your screenshots, I don't see any obvious issues. Please check two things: ensure the IP addresses are correct on both devices, and confirm the PG/PC interface is set up properly—this step is crucial for successful operation. Disabling your firewall might also help, as it can cause connection problems.
Thank you for your response. Please find attached the [product_name] program file. Appreciate your help.

Hi, I reviewed your project file. The issue seems to be with the PG/PC Interface setting; you need to adjust it according to the type of connection you're using. For your case, it should be set to Ethernet TCP/IP (Auto). Upon setting this, communication should work. I've tested the Runtime on my PC and it's successful. I could issue commands using your project file without any other changes. Please see the attachment. You can find the PG/PC Interface settings in the Control Panel of the computer running the Runtime. I didn't notice any problem with your [product_name] configuration either. It operates as expected. If the connection keeps disconnecting or shows alarms, something may be wrong with the network configuration. All other settings function well for me. Try running the Runtime in Administrator mode; sometimes network permissions are blocked. Thanks,
Hello [user_name], Hello [company_name] Global, It's likely the PG/PC Interface setting is causing the problem, but also consider disabling your firewall, as it can occasionally interfere.

Hello, I found some time to rerun a test and verified the connection works. I created a simple program that starts and stops a custom stopwatch, displaying operating time on the operator interface. As shown in the attached file, communication has been established between the devices. Don't worry—it's just a matter of reviewing each setting carefully. Feel free to ask questions about any step. Responses may take a little time due to work commitments, but I will reply. Greetings.

The troubleshooting highlighted a need for clearer error messages, intuitive interface setup, and guidance for resolving network or interface issues.
